message: W14 isolated publisher setup, read-only preflight only until all existing gates pass. Accepted clean source is b6559a27afcee954bad73772f2fd9c1db7ced117, review f129f0eb decision9974. Build to private output. Before launching, verify resolved application-data/config/data paths under a fresh private profile: DeviceIdentity uses ApplicationData/Jarvis/device-id, OAuth and browser-schedules share ClientConfig config directory, and activity uses LocalApplicationData. On Linux isolate both XDG config and data roots and verify actual resolution. Use fresh distinct device UUID/name and normal approved OAuth login (same authorized account), never share/copy the live refresh token, and verify callback port is available and approved. Use a scratch workspace bound only to the exact canonical Jarvis repository/ledger, keep browser bridge omitted, schedule state empty, native Health OFF and no scheduler/provider setup. Check existing serving device/connection stays registered and route every isolated read/write by its explicit deviceId from your session, without changing defaults or touching the old PID. Confirm source/binary hash, authenticated registration and read-only correct ledger/remote binding first. Inspect existing serving journals and prior UUID outcomes before any switch; clean isolated journals alone prove nothing about prior effects. If fresh auth, route/binding, existing pending effects or any gate cannot be confirmed, HOLD and record the exact input needed. Existing W14 conditional GO and sole Integrator custody, no duplicate job/push or BN050 overlap. W8 one-assertion lease applies only to its own W21-derived branch.
